title: marketplace install-local: a composed bundle's seed datasets (packages[i] data) are never loaded on install, reseed or upgrade, so a hosted tenant gets no demo data for a new module
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Priority p1 under the maintainer's rule that every Chinese (zh-CN) demo-data issue is p1, platform side included. Found while answering the maintainer's question of 2026-11-16: why the hosted HotCRM 6.4.0 tenant shows no demo data in 订单与回款 (crm_o2c) or 项目交付 (crm_psa).

**Shape of the artifact.** Since HotCRM 6.2.0 (hotcrm#2456, the composed publish of ADR-0130 D4), `dist/objectstack.json` carries `packages[]`, one assembled body per package. A multi-package artifact has no flattened copy beside it, so there is **no top-level `data`**. The seed datasets sit in each package body: about 800 rows across 5 packages in the 6.4 build (hotcrm main 3617fbd).

**What install-local reads.** `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`:
- `seedDatasetsOf(manifest)` (around line 1210) and `applySideEffects` (around line 6845) read only `manifest.data`.
- They never call `resolveStackCollection(artifact, 'data')`, which the rename planner and the upgrade plan already use to fold package bodies.
- So install, reseed (`purgeSeedDatasets`) and the upgrade replay of a composed bundle all report "no-datasets".

**Measured** on `@objectstack/cloud-connection` 18.5.0 with the HotCRM 6.4 build (main 3617fbd), calling `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin.applySideEffects` on `dist/objectstack.json` as built:
- **0** seed datasets merged into the kernel ("no-datasets");
- the same artifact with the package datasets copied to a top-level `data` merged **48**.

**Ask.**
1. Install and reseed read the seed datasets of every package body (`resolveStackCollection(…, 'data')` or the per-package equivalent), in the artifact's package order.
2. An upgrade replays seed keys that are new in the incoming version into existing organizations, so a module added by an upgrade (HotCRM PSA in 6.4.0) gets its demo rows. `sys_seed_landed_key` already keeps a row a tenant deleted from coming back.

**Not readable from here.** Whether the hosted cloud's upgrade path goes through the same code. The cloud repository answers 403 to the fleet, so a cloud seat should confirm that half.

Re-check: `git grep -n "manifest.data" packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`.

Responsibility: platform (cloud-connection install-local). HotCRM cannot ship around it: the composed shape is the ruled publish format, and re-flattening is refused.
